physical_config_note: only the frozen flow files, their SHA-256, the lambda2 thresholds and the RK45 tracer settings are read from this file

sampling.rule: uniform-by-volume points inside candidate cells kept only when trilinear lambda2<threshold and oyf>0 (step1); random permutation; greedy dart throwing with the largest radius that still accepts >= N points; the first N accepted points are the samples

integration.rule: one bidirectional fixed-step RK45 integration to the longest length; the shorter lengths are the first n_k steps of each half; a half line that left the fluid domain (VTK termination OUT_OF_DOMAIN) only needs [0.25L, 1.25L] of arc, every other half needs [0.95L, 1.002L]; a sample is kept only when all three curves pass
